video.title: AI欧腐《高冷Alpha的呆萌Omega/The Cold Alpha's Stupid Omega》
video.desc:
好多人求的 还是做一下 好适合学英语的剧 
Cole, a naive Omega sent into a wealthy family by his father as a debt bargaining chip, mistakes a private arrangement for marriage. Adrian, an Alpha who once didn’t believe in love, learns to cherish and commit through their time together, ultimately turning a “fake home” into a mutually consensual, legally recognized marriage.
天真的 Omega Cole 被父亲当作抵债的筹码送进了豪门，却把一纸私下的契约当成了真正的婚姻。曾经不相信爱情的 Alpha Adrian，在与他朝夕相处的日子里，学会了珍惜与承诺——最终，一个"假的家"，变成了一段两情相悦、受法律承认的真婚姻。
